exam_scheme.note: Uttarakhand Teacher Eligibility Test (UTET) is conducted annually by the Uttarakhand Board of School Education (UBSE), Ramnagar (Nainital) under guidelines framed by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) and the Government of Uttarakhand School Education Department. The examination determines statutory eligibility for appointment as elementary teachers in state government, aided, and private schools across Uttarakhand. The examination comprises two independent papers: UTET-I for Primary Teachers (Classes I to V) and UTET-II for Upper Primary / Elementary Teachers (Classes VI to VIII). Each paper consists of 150 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 150 marks for a duration of 2.5 hours (150 minutes). Questions are bilingual in Hindi and English (except specific language sections). There is no negative marking. Per Uttarakhand Government Order No. 889/XXIV-A-1/2021-15/2011 Vol-I dated 28.06.2021, the UTET qualifying certificate is valid for a lifetime with retrospective effect from 11.02.2011.
